verdict.rationale: Poly is an AI file-storage SaaS, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair ask. However, the evidence documents no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and a probe of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404. The MCP server and CLI are separate capabilities, not a published API spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
